note: This pillar is dormant by the CEO's standing instruction. Dormancy suppresses quiet, never red: a public promise the build contradicts still reaches him, because the store page is the one surface outsiders can see.

verdict_template.fire: Dormant — and the store page is promising something the build no longer does: {worst}
verdict_template.ok: Dormant, and nothing here is contradicting itself.

goals.statement: The store page does not promise anything the build has stopped doing.
goals.statement_short: the store page promises no words to read, and the build now has words to read
goals.why_it_matters: This is the only pillar that can be falsified by its own product. The page says 'no menus to learn and no words to read'; every English label the build adds makes that sentence less true, and a stranger can check it in ten seconds.

measure.label: English labels the build asks a player to read
measure.unit: English label a player has to read
measure.unit_plural: English labels a player has to read

path_to_green.narrative: Either the machine menu gets pictures, or the store page stops claiming there is nothing to read. Both are honest; the gap between them is not — and it is your taste call, prepped and waiting.

ceo_blocker.consequence: The wordless promise becomes something we keep only where it is easy, and the next machine panel argues from this one.

goals.statement: There is a written number that turns this pillar on, so waking up is a reading rather than a feeling.
goals.statement_short: nothing is written down that would tell us marketing should wake up
goals.why_it_matters: A dormant org with no trigger is not waiting, it is asleep. The difference is one sentence, and only you can write it.

measure.label: a number is written down that would wake this pillar up
measure.says_false: nothing is written down that would wake this pillar up

path_to_green.narrative: One sentence from you: the event or the number that makes marketing worth switching on. It can be a date, a build, or a wishlist count — it only has to be checkable.

ceo_blocker.consequence: Marketing stays off by inertia rather than by decision, and finds out late either way.

goals.statement: Nothing reaches the public without you pushing a tag.
goals.statement_short: something could reach the public without a tag you pushed
goals.why_it_matters: A floor, not an achievement — but the one guarantee that makes a dormant marketing org safe rather than negligent.

measure.label: the release workflow fires on a pushed tag and nothing else

goals.statement: If people showed up on the store page, we would know.
goals.statement_short: nobody would notice if people started arriving
goals.why_it_matters: One public build has been live for weeks. Whether anybody has opened it is a fact nobody in this studio can state.

path_to_green.narrative: An itch API key, kept in the project .env like the other two. That single credential turns this whole pillar from guesses into readings.

ceo_blocker.consequence: The first sign of an audience arrives by accident, or not at all.

goals.statement: The store page still describes the game we have.
goals.statement_short: the store page has not been touched since long before the current build

path_to_green.narrative: Reread the page against the build before the next tag; the copy is the release's front door.
